perks.name: Deconstruct

Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Stasis builds. Appetence is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "high utility for shot count-sensitive use cases, Harsh Refraction makes damage profile competitive". It's accessible and shapable at the Mars Relic - even with the older perk pool it can still be useful. The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The Recoil Direction is pretty good at base, so you can tidy that up to 100 with the barrel perk, or look for your preference of Handling, Stability or Range. For the battery perk, Tactical or Light Battery boost gunfeel stats or Enhanced Battery adds a few extra shots. In the first trait perk slot, to delay the need to reload, Overflow refills the battery and boosts its capacity to ×2.2 of base, rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick or Clown Cartridge overflows the battery by between ×1.13-1.5 randomly on a manual reload. There's also Demolitionist which generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant battery refill on grenade use. For Stasis synergy, in the second column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill - these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. Aegis ranks the Dragon's Vengeance origin trait as D-Tier for PvE - it refills the battery from reserves, and grants +10 Range and +5 Handling with a ×0.975 Draw Time scalar for 11s after reaching critical health or on the death of an ally. If you're interested, the name's derived from the Latin "appetere" (to desire or reach for). "Appetence" means an intense natural desire, craving, or instinctive appetite, reflecting the Ahamkara's manipulation of desire during Season of the Wish. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 92 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2qpoxXfXzBXohHBrdQnHbd?si=aH9jqq3kRwOtwQoh2YhHDA) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor spec enemies in end-game content. Shapeable. Appetence (which means "a natural craving, desire or affinity", seeing as you're asking) is the first legendary Stasis trace rifle. It has decent stats, and some interesting trait combinations. Take your pick of handling and/or stability and maybe a touch of recoil direction, if you need it to be a perfect 100, for the barrel perk. With an eye on Overflow as the support perk in the first trait column, Ionized Battery maximises the battery size. Enhanced Overflow gives you 229 in the battery, and 476 total ammo (so 247 in reserve) with no Reserve mods, up to 606 with three. Killing Tally is the best of the damage perks here, providing a 30% non-timed damage boost as long as you don't swap weapons. With Overflow topping up the battery, for just picking up an ammo brick, this could mean a pretty-much permanent bonus damage. The Dragon's Vengeance origin trait can be useful, although it only procs once your health bar turns red or an ally dies. You'll get a reload and 11s of a boost to range and either charge rate or handling. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Being a stasis trace rifle already gives Appetence viability in a lot of loadouts. No longer are you tied to Ager’s Scepter for a “kinetic” trace rifle. Appetence is also legendary so you open up a plethora of loadout possibilities. In PvE you can make the most of this trace rifle with Overflow and Killing Tally for a 21% Delirium-lite. Being able to walk over bricks of special to double the magazine capacity keeps Killing Tally primed and ready to rip into any wave of enemy you might have in front of you. If you prefer a more calculated approach or don’t want to use just one weapon, Headstone is extremely strong with the buffed Stasis subclasses." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Taking Appetence into the crucible might be a big test of your patience. Already having low ammo, and the current economy of ammo bricks will severely limit your overall usage. If you can horde ammo bricks like Scrooge you can certainly make this weapon work better. Enlightened Action will make the weapon feel better, and Headstone can deny revives or build into the Stasis subclass like in PvE. Killing Tally can work if you use nothing but this trace rifle but I wouldn’t advise it." Recommended MW: Range.
